Meta.title: Pantheus — Custom ERP for Vietnamese manufacturing
Meta.description: Custom ERP for Vietnamese manufacturing — built around how you work, running on your own ground, answering your questions.

Hero.subhead: Custom ERP for Vietnamese manufacturing — built around how you actually work. On your servers. Answering your questions.
Hero.tagline: The foundation your operations stand on.

Problem.heading: Running on spreadsheets and guesswork.
Problem.body: “How many of this model can I build right now?” With spreadsheets, that question takes hours — and the answer is already out of date. No single source of truth, no view of supplier quality, inventory lost to manual error.

builtAroundYou.label: Built around you
builtAroundYou.headline: Your process is the spec.
builtAroundYou.body: We don't bend your factory to fit the software. We shape the software around how your factory already runs — and you own it outright, with no per-seat subscription.

runsOnYourGround.label: Runs on your ground
runsOnYourGround.headline: Your data never leaves the building.
runsOnYourGround.body: On-premise and offline-capable. Full control, no cloud dependency, no recurring hosting fees — it keeps working when the internet doesn't.

outcomes.label: Outcomes, not modules
outcomes.headline: Every feature ties to a number you care about.
outcomes.body: We start from your bottleneck, not a feature list — inventory loss down, stoppages avoided, working capital freed. If it doesn't move a number, we don't build it.

builtForTheFloor.label: Built for the floor
builtForTheFloor.headline: Simple enough for everyone to actually use.
builtForTheFloor.body: Adoption is where ERP projects die. Designed for non-technical workers: minimal training, fast onboarding, clean data from day one.

askYourFactory.label: Ask your factory
askYourFactory.headline: Ask in plain language. Get a real answer.
askYourFactory.body: AI that turns operations data into decisions. “How many can I ship this week?” “Which supplier costs me most in defects?” — answered, without reading a dashboard.

step1.title: Understand
step1.body: We study your operation and find the bottleneck that costs you most.

step2.title: Build
step2.body: We ship a system that solves it, shaped around your real process.

step3.title: Grow
step3.body: We extend it as you scale, on your terms.

Audience.heading: Who it's for.
Audience.body: Manufacturing SMEs outgrowing spreadsheets — ready for a system that fits, not a template to wrestle with.

Closing.heading: Let's build the system your factory deserves.
Closing.subline: No template. No lock-in. Just a system built for you.

Footer.wordmarkLine: Pantheus — ERP for manufacturing, built around you.
Footer.tagline: The foundation your operations stand on.
